Article Title: ‘It's now or never’: India Youth Congress calls for mass mobilisation in Delhi on October 12 over ‘vote chori’ allegations
Article Text:
Indian Youth Congress has announced a protest on October 12 to defend democracy and the Constitution.

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: Indian Youth Congress has announced a ‘Chalo Delhi’ mobilisation on October 12, urging people to join its campaign to defend the Constitution and democracy amid the Congress-led Opposition’s allegations of electoral irregularities and its demand for accountability from the Election Commission.The announcement comes amid a series of protests by Rahul Gandhi and other INDIA bloc leaders against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.In a series of posts on X, the youth wing used the slogan “It's NOW or NEVER” and accused the BJP of rigging elections with the help of a “compromised Election Commission”. It called on people to stand up peacefully for their voting rights, freedom and constitutional protections.The organisation also invoked Mahatma Gandhi and India's freedom struggle, arguing that the country belongs to its people and not to any political party. The posts repeated the October 12 date and the slogan, “For our Constitution. For our democracy. For each other.”The announcement follows protests by Rahul Gandhi and other Opposition leaders in New Delhi. On October 8, Delhi Police detained Gandhi, Congress leader Priyanka Gandhi Vadra and around 90 other Opposition MPs and workers as they attempted to reach Jantar Mantar for a demonstration against the Election Commission.On October 9, Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge and Rahul Gandhi led an INDIA bloc delegation that submitted a memorandum to President Droupadi Murmu against what the Opposition calls “vote chori”.According to the Congress's official press release, the delegation raised concerns about the electoral process and sought the President's intervention. The meeting was part of the Opposition's broader campaign challenging the Election Commission's handling of electoral rolls and demanding accountability from its leadership.
Article Summary: Indian Youth Congress has announced a ‘Chalo Delhi’ mobilisation on October 12. The announcement comes amid a series of protests by Rahul Gandhi and other INDIA bloc leaders against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The youth wing accused the BJP of rigging elections with the help of a “compromised Election Commission”

Article Title: 'Modi ji himself may have to resign': Kejriwal's Hitler jibe over Delhi protest crackdown
Article Text:
Kejriwal slams Centre over Delhi crackdown

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: A day after police cracked down on the Cockroach Janta Party’s (CJP) proposed protest in Delhi, Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) supremo Arvind Kejriwal turned his fire on Prime Minister Narendra Modi , invoking Hitler to attack the Centre’s handling of the demonstration and warning that the demand for resignation could extend beyond CEC Gyanesh Kumar.In a video shared on X, Kejriwal accused the authorities of mistreating protesters, including young women, lawyers and journalists, during Saturday’s crackdown.Also read: Turn any spot into your own Jantar Mantar, says Arvind Kejriwal “The way Modi ji unleashed a reign of terror yesterday, he crossed all limits and left even Hitler behind. Videos of his atrocities are circulating everywhere. Young girls are being subjected to atrocities and mistreated. Lawyers were not spared, journalists were not spared — no one was spared. It should not come to a point where, along with Gyanesh Kumar, Modi ji himself is forced to resign this time,” Kejriwal said in a video message.The CJP had called for a mass demonstration at Jantar Mantar, demanding Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation over SIR. However, an extensive security crackdown significantly curtailed the planned protest, with police detaining party leaders and supporters across the national capital.CJP leaders Abhijeet Dipke, Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das were among those detained after arriving at Delhi’s Indira Gandhi International Airport. Police also detained several opposition leaders, including Kejriwal, West Bengal chief minister Mamata Banerjee and Kerala chief minister Pinarayi Vijayan, along with YouTuber Dhruv Rathee.The crackdown resulted in more than 7,000 detentions, triggering allegations of excessive restrictions on peaceful assembly and the treatment of protesters.The Supreme Court has issued notice to the Centre on a contempt plea alleging violation of its earlier directions and called for measures to prevent illegal detention of peaceful protesters and ensure normal transport services.
Article Summary: Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) supremo Arvind Kejriwal turned his fire on Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Kejriwal accused the authorities of mistreating protesters, including young women, lawyers and journalists. The CJP had called for a mass demonstration at Jantar Mantar, demanding Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation.

Article Title: 'BJP's honouring women': Akhilesh shares video of harassment during Delhi crackdown
Article Text:
Akhilesh shares video of alleged harassment during Delhi crackdown

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: Samajwadi Party supremo Akhilesh Yadav on Sunday took a swipe at the BJP over alleged incidents of harassment and violence against women during the crackdown on the Cockroach Janta Party’s (CJP) proposed protest at Jantar Mantar in Delhi, which was brought to a halt with thousands of people detained, including several political leaders.The protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar was effectively reduced to a story of restrictions, detentions and containment, with Delhi Police enforcing security measures ahead of the proposed showdown.Akhilesh shared a video on X purportedly showing multiple incidents in which women were allegedly harassed and assaulted by men dressed in civilian clothes. Targeting the ruling BJP, the former Uttar Pradesh chief minister wrote: “The country's capital, drowned in shame! This is the truth of BJP's 'honoring women.' Disgraceful!”Mamata-led Trinamool Congress MP Mahua Moitra also shared a video, directly targeting the RSS. She wrote: “What’s worrying in this video is not that RSS goon Raman is assaulting women. What is worrying is Delhi police is telling him to go & ensure camera is off.”Saturday’s proposed protest at Jantar Mantar was met with a massive security deployment, with around 35,000 police personnel mobilised. Security restrictions, including metro service curbs and internet shutdowns, were also reported as authorities moved to prevent the demonstration from escalating.The heavy police presence and surveillance in the national capital curtailed the protest before it could gain momentum.CJP leaders Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were detained shortly after arriving in Delhi by air.Several other leaders, including former chief ministers Arvind Kejriwal, Mamata Banerjee and Pinarayi Vijayan, were also detained amid the crackdown.
Article Summary: Samajwadi Party supremo Akhilesh Yadav took a swipe at the BJP over alleged incidents of harassment and violence against women. Akhilesh shared a video purportedly showing multiple incidents in which women were allegedly harassed and assaulted by men dressed in civilian clothes.

Article Title: 'Will talk about undeclared Emergency': Kharge says Congress to meet CJI over ‘vote chori’ allegations
Article Text:
Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge has announced plans for a meeting with the Chief Justice of India

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge on Sunday said party leaders would meet the Chief Justice of India (CJI) to raise concerns over the functioning of constitutional institutions, while accusing the BJP of coming to power through “vote chori” and alleging that the country was witnessing an “undeclared Emergency”.According to ANI, Kharge said he and senior Congress leader Rahul Gandhi had written letters to the CJI and that a meeting had been scheduled between 4 pm and 5 pm. He clarified that the delegation would present its concerns rather than demand any specific action.“We can't demand anything from him. Only with folded hand we'll request them,” Kharge said in Bengaluru.Kharge also alleged that the Election Commission was not being allowed to function independently and claimed that concerns over irregularities within the poll body had gone unaddressed.“The CEC is a constitutional body. They are independent. They can take independent decisions. But he is not allowing them to take independent decisions,” he said.Referring to concerns raised by two Election Commission members, Kharge alleged that irregularities in the commission's functioning had been exposed but no action had followed. He claimed that the government wanted “vote chori” to continue and alleged that electoral malpractice had helped the BJP form governments at the Centre and in states.“Whatever 'vote chori' he has done, with that only, he has formed the government in the Centre and the states,” Kharge said.Kharge also criticised the Chief Election Commissioner and Other Election Commissioners (Appointment, Conditions of Service and Term of Office) Act, 2023, questioning the legal protection it provides to election commissioners for acts performed in the discharge of their official duties.“That immunity he gave. That immunity is not even for the President of India, not the Chief Justice, but that is given to one Election Commissioner. Why?” he said.Kharge alleged that the provision weakened accountability and linked it to electoral irregularities involving electronic voting machines (EVMs). Calling it a conspiracy against democracy, he said, “It means that it is a conspiracy to snatch votes and commit fraud on democracy, and he is doing all that, and we'll fight it.”Kharge further accused Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union Home Minister Amit Shah of creating an atmosphere of fear and political instability, describing the situation as an “undeclared Emergency”.Referring to the deployment of nearly 32,000 police personnel during protests, he questioned the scale of the security arrangements and said they reflected the government's apprehension.“Yesterday, nearly 32,000 policemen were deployed. That itself shows how much fear he has,” Kharge said.
Article Summary: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge has announced plans for a meeting with the Chief Justice of India. Kharge said he and senior Congress leader Rahul Gandhi had written letters to the CJI and that a meeting had been scheduled between 4 pm and 5 pm. The delegation would present its concerns rather than demand any specific action.

Article Title: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee released late night after being detained in Gurgaon
Article Text:
YouTuber Dhruv Rathee





GURGAON: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee was released late on Saturday after being detained at his home in Haryana’s Gurgaon, news agency PTI reported.Rathee had travelled to India to join the Cockroach Janta Party’s ( CJP ) protest demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged electoral roll irregularities.He was detained from his home in Sector 56 on Saturday morning after he refused to "heed police warnings" against attending the demonstration, for which permission had not been granted.Around 30 policemen in plainclothes reached Rathee’s home in Kendriya Vihar around 7.30am and took him into custody. He was subsequently taken to the crime branch office in Sector 39, where he remained in detention until late Saturday evening.A police officer said Rathee had been warned against joining the demonstration because permission had not been granted and prohibitory orders were in force under Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS).
Article Summary: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee was released late on Saturday after being detained at his home in Haryana’s Gurgaon. Rathee had travelled to India to join the Cockroach Janta Party's ( CJP ) protest demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

Article Title: ‘Thanks for teaching youngsters’: Tharoor takes dig at PM Modi, shares 2015 tweet
Article Text:
Tharoor’s jibe came on a day of heightened security, mass detentions and a political showdown in the national capital

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: Congress leader Shashi Tharoor late Saturday took a dig at Prime Minister Narendra Modi by sharing his 2015 tweet about the Emergency. Tharoor drew a parallel with the current situation in Delhi, where police cracked down on protesters demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.“Thanks for teaching today’s youngsters many of the same lessons, Modiji!” Tharoor wrote on X while sharing Modi’s post dated June 25, 2015. In the old tweet, Modi had said, “Personally, the Emergency brings back many memories. As youngsters, we learnt a lot during the anti-Emergency movement.”Tharoor’s jibe came on a day of heightened security, mass detentions and a political showdown in the national capital, where a protest organised by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) was met with a heavy police deployment. 7,000 people were detained (and later released), including several Opposition leaders, while 45 Metro stations were closed till 10pm amid extensive security arrangements.Earlier in the day, Tharoor had criticised the government over the restrictions, describing the situation as a “war-like deployment” and saying that “our GenZ deserves better than an undeclared Emer-GenZ”.The Thiruvananthapuram MP said he had returned to Delhi after 2 am and had rarely witnessed anything like the security measures in place across the capital.He cited checkpoints, concrete barricades, spike strips, the deployment of 22,000 police and paramilitary personnel, cancelled train services and reports of young people being detained.Questioning the suspension of internet services in the heart of the national capital and restrictions on access to Jantar Mantar, Tharoor said the government should answer questions about the integrity of elections rather than prevent citizens from raising them.“The government should provide answers, not lathis; expression, not repression,” he said, adding that barricades would do nothing to restore public faith in the Election Commission.The CJP protest had triggered a wider political confrontation, with Opposition leaders accusing the government of suppressing democratic dissent, while the BJP accused protest organisers of attempting to destabilise the country.Delhi Police sources told ANI that all detainees had been released from detention centres except CJP leaders, for whom due legal process would be followed. The Supreme Court is scheduled to hear a contempt petition on Sunday over allegations that the closure of Metro stations violated its October 9 order.
Article Summary: Tharoor’s jibe came on a day of heightened security, mass detentions and a political showdown in the national capital. In the old tweet, Modi had said, “Personally, the Emergency brings back many memories. As youngsters, we learnt a lot during the anti-Emergency movement.”

Article Title: ‘Grandmother's rites on hold': Abhijeet Dipke's mother claims Delhi Police is lying over giving him the news
Article Text:
Abhijeet Dipke’s mother says family unable to contact him

NEW DELHI: The mother of Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke, Anita Dipke, on Sunday accused Delhi Police of lying about informing her son of his grandmother’s death, saying the family had been unable to contact him and had postponed the last rites until he could return.“We have not been able to contact him...Delhi Police is lying. If he got the news (his grandmother's demise), he would have come immediately...we have put the last rites on hold for him...” Anita Dipke said.Delhi Police had earlier said it informed Dipke about his grandmother’s death while he remained in detention in the national capital ahead of the party’s proposed protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.“It is now up to him whether he wants to stay back and continue the protest under detention or fly back for the last rites,” Delhi Police sources told news agency ANI on Saturday.Dipke’s paternal grandmother, Savitribai Shankarrao Dipke, 85, died at her home in Santuk Pimpri village in Maharashtra’s Hingoli district at 11.30 am on Saturday following a prolonged illness, family sources told PTI. She had been unwell for about a month and was previously hospitalised in Hingoli.Her last rites were scheduled for 10 am on Sunday.An Executive Magistrate has ordered the release of CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke, co-convenor Saurav Das and party leader Ashutosh Ranka following their preventive detention by Delhi Police on Saturday.The three were detained after arriving in the national capital from Mumbai to participate in the party’s proposed ‘Jantar Mantar 2.0’ protest, which sought the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.Delhi Police had denied permission for the demonstration, citing public safety, traffic management and law-and-order concerns. Security was subsequently tightened across the capital ahead of the planned protest.
Article Summary: Anita Dipke, mother of CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke says family unable to contact him. Delhi Police had earlier said it informed Dipke about his grandmother’s death while he remained in detention in the national capital. Savitribai Shankarrao Dipke died on Saturday following a prolonged illness.

Article Title: SIR stir: 'Kashmir model' in Delhi, situation akin to Emergency, says opposition
Article Text:

(Inputs from Srinagar, Thiruvananthapuram, Chennai, Mohali)

Internet restrictions and arrests during Cockroach Janta Party-led anti-SIR protests in New Delhi triggered sharp political reactions Saturday, as J&K CM Omar Abdullah said the "Kashmir model" had reached the capital, PDP chief Mehbooba Mufti called the restrictions a reminder of Kashmir's 2019 lockdown, and CPM described the atmosphere as "akin to the Emergency".Omar said the "Kashmir model has been exported to Delhi. Welcome to the New Delhi, modelled on New Jammu & Kashmir." Deputy CM Surinder Choudhary questioned whether the situation was any less serious than during the Emergency and called for chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation. National Conference spokesperson Sarah Hayat Shah said New Delhi was witnessing "barely .1% of what was done to Kashmir on Aug 5, 2019. "Former CM Mehbooba Mufti called the crackdown "a chilling reminder of Kashmir after the unconstitutional" abrogation of Article 370. "People were locked in their homes, the internet was shut down, and an entire region was placed under siege," she said, recalling her detention for 14 months after Centre revoked J&K's special status and split it into two Union territories in Aug 2019.Leh Apex Body member and climate activist Sonam Wangchuk gave govt 24 hours to release those detained during the New Delhi protest, warning he could launch a sit-in, hunger strike or march in Leh or the capital city."It appears an undeclared emergency has been imposed across the country," he said, urging govt to resolve the dispute through dialogue.In Punjab, CM Bhagwant Mann slammed Union govt over the detentions. "Where is democracy? Around 80,000 to 90,000 security personnel have been deployed. It is only short of deploying Army to stop them. They are students, they are unarmed. They have come for the sake democracy so that their votes are not deleted... if Gen-Z is coming forward, they should be allowed. Why is Centre scared of Jantar Mantar now?" he said.AAP workers, led by Punjab party in charge Manish Sisodia, held a "vote chori" protest against Kumar outside the chief electoral officer's office in Chandigarh. "If Narendra Modi were genuinely popular and had won elections honestly, he would not be afraid of a few young people sitting at Jantar Mantar. But he is afraid because he has become PM by stealing votes, deleting genuine voters and adding fake votes," Sisodia alleged.In Chennai, DMK president and former Tamil Nadu CM MK Stalin condemned the detention of politicians and students protesting against SIR, while Kumar continued to enjoy Z+ security. "Barricading #Delhi, shutting down the internet and detaining politicians cannot crush the uprising of India's youth," he said, demanding Kumar's removal, a halt to SIR and the release of detainees.In Keralam, CPM condemned the detentions as creating an atmosphere "akin to the Emergency" and accused Delhi police of acting like "RSS-BJP goons". Top CPM functionaries along with MPs and functionaries of the party's women's, student and youth wings were detained while trying to join the Jantar Mantar protest. CPM called for demonstrations across Keralam.Congress general secretary KC Venugopal accused PM Modi and Union home minister Amit Shah of protecting Kumar at political cost. He said the closure of Delhi Metro stations to curb protesters reflected BJP-led NDA govt's anxiety and announced a large INDIA bloc protest in the capital Monday.
Article Summary: Cockroach Janta Party-led anti-SIR protests in New Delhi triggered sharp political reactions. J&K CM Omar Abdullah said the "Kashmir model" had reached the capital. PDP chief Mehbooba Mufti called the restrictions a reminder of Kashmir's 2019 lockdown.

Article Title: 'Tata bye-bye': 2-term BJP MP quits party over Rajya Sabha ticket snub
Article Text: MEERUT: Former two-term BJP MP from Aonla in Bareilly, Dharmendra Kashyap, resigned from the party's primary and active membership, alleging that members who worked against BJP during Lok Sabha polls were being rewarded while backward and most backward communities were denied adequate representation and respect. His resignation came days after BJP announced its RS nominees, prompting Kashyap to post "Tata bye-bye" on social media.Kashyap announced his decision through a social media post addressed to BJP national president, state president, Braj region chief and district chief.He did not name anyone in his resignation, but his decision followed BJP's nomination of Shruti Gangwar to RS. Speculation had been growing that he was unhappy with the choice as he had been expecting a nomination himself.The party has not announced whether it has accepted Kashyap's resignation or plans to address his grievances.
Article Summary: Former two-term BJP MP from Aonla in Bareilly, Dharmendra Kashyap, resigned from the party's primary and active membership. He alleged that members who worked against BJP during Lok Sabha polls were being rewarded while backward and most backward communities were denied adequate representation and respect. His resignation came days after BJP announced its RS nominees.

Article Title: Manipur MP calls his dismissal as JNU prof 'witch hunt'

GUWAHATI: Congress MP Angomcha Bimol Akoijam has called his dismissal as a professor of JNU a "witch hunt" and accused the institution of violating procedures for handling sexual harassment complaints."I have not received the internal committee recommendations and even the official dismissal order yet," Akoijam, who represents Inner Manipur, said, adding, "I have nothing to hide. This is a witch hunt." He said he would challenge the move through legal channels.Akoijam was dismissed from JNU after the university's internal committee inquired into allegations of sexual harassment by women students and recommended major punishment.At a presser at his residence in Imphal Friday night, Akoijam said JNU had disclosed his identity despite the confidentiality requirement. He said he learnt about the development through the media and had not received the inquiry report or recommendations. "The parties concerned should be given an opportunity to appeal against the findings within the stipulated 30-day period," he said.Meanwhile, Manipur CM Yumnam Khemchand Singh demanded Akoijam's resignation from Lok Sabha.In a social media post, he called the dismissal "deeply disturbing and shameful." Khemchand said the professor has tarnished Manipur's image. "Akoijam has lost the moral authority to continue as a public representative and should resign, respecting the sentiment of the people," he said.Former Manipur CM N Biren Singh attacked the Congress leadership. "Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi will have to pay for harbouring someone facing serious sexual allegations for political gain," he said.The issue also resonated in Jammu, where BJP staged a protest seeking Rahul's resignation as LoP.
Article Summary: Angomcha Bimol Akoijam was dismissed from JNU after the university's internal committee inquired into allegations of sexual harassment by women students. Article Title: Delimitation a design to punish TN reduce its voice in Parliament: Rahul Gandhi
Article Text:

CHENNAI: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi made his youth outreach programme ‘Chhatron Ki Goonj’ held at Chennai’s Island Grounds, the platform to take on PM Narendra Modi led govt over its attempts to bring the delimitation bill in the garb of women's reservation, alleging that delimitation was a design to punish Tamil Nadu and reduce its voice in Parliament.“It is an attack on Tamil Nadu, we are not going to let Modi attack Tamil language, history and culture,” he said amidst thundering applause and cheers by thousands of students. “We are not going to let him touch Tamil Nadu”, he reiterated.The statement on delimitation at a programme in Chennai gains significance as it comes amid Congress' former ally DMK ’s wavering position on the issue and the shift in equations in the state after Congress abandoned DMK and decided to support C Joseph Vijay to form govt.In his address, Gandhi also brought up the sensitive three-language formula issue. Gandhi accused Modi and Shah of attacking the culture, language, history and tradition of the state."Amit Shah openly says that Hindi will be imposed on Tamil Nadu. It is Modi and Shah who are stifling curiosity. This is happening through the New Education Policy; a three-language formula has been imposed," he said.Interestingly, Gandhi at the outset invoked Periyar, telling students that they must not follow anything just because somebody was saying it, till they don’t analyse and inquire about it themselves.It is well known that DMK traces its foundational roots to EV Ramasamy, known as Periyar, though their relationship has been a mix of ideological reverence and strategic separation.“Thiruvalluvar ji wrote, "The deeper you dig a well in sand, the more water springs up; the more you learn, the more knowledge flows," Gandhi further said as he dwelled on the importance of curiosity and the need to ask questions.Earlier in the day, Gandhi met TVK president and Tamil Nadu chief minister C Joseph Vijay at his suburban Neelankarai residence where they were in a luncheon meeting for an hour, and are learnt to have discussed several political issues.Later, they visited Bask by Coffee, a cafe in the neighbourhood.Following the interaction, both Rahul Gandhi and Vijay stepped out of his Neelankarai residence together and instead of parting at the gates, they chose to walk together surrounded by a heavy multi-tier security, and a large group of cheering supporters.The meeting between Gandhi and the Tamil Nadu CM is also the first after TVK became a part of the INDIA bloc and came immediately after the ruling party's win in the bypolls to Madurantakam and Dharapuram assembly constituencies.
Article Summary: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi made his youth outreach programme ‘Chhatron Ki Goonj’ held at Chennai’s Island Grounds. Gandhi accused Modi and Shah of attacking the culture, language, history and tradition of the state.

Article Title: Delhi protests: SC to hear plea seeking contempt action against authorities on Sunday
Article Text:
SC hearing on Sunday

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: The Supreme Court will hear on Sunday a plea seeking contempt proceedings against authorities for allegedly violating its October 9 direction on maintaining metro and train services during protests in Delhi.The plea will be heard on Sunday by a bench of Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana, according to the Supreme Court’s cause list. It seeks contempt proceedings against Union Home Secretary Govind Mohan, Delhi Police Commissioner Anurag Kumar and DMRC chairperson D Thara.Filed by advocate Shailendra Mani Tripathi through advocate Chand Qureshi, the petition alleges that the authorities deliberately failed to comply with the court’s directions. “This brutal assault on the fundamental rights of the citizens and sheer disregard to the orders of this court amounts to deliberate, intentional attempt on the part of Delhi Metro, Delhi Police and the Union government which must be dealt with an iron hand,” it said, as quoted by PTI.The dispute stems from restrictions imposed ahead of the Cockroach Janta Party’s (CJP) proposed demonstration at Jantar Mantar on October 10.The party and student organisations had called for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation over alleged irregularities in the functioning of the Election Commission.Ahead of the protest, the closure of 57 metro stations and cancellation of trains to Delhi were challenged in a separate petition before the Supreme Court. On October 9, a bench comprising Chief Justice Surya Kant and Justices Bagchi and Mohana directed the Centre to ensure there was no “complete prohibition” on metro and train movement into the capital the following day.The court acknowledged that law enforcement agencies could take steps to prevent unruly movement but said citizens should not face undue harassment. It also cautioned against bringing all transport services to a halt because of the proposed demonstration.Delhi nevertheless witnessed extensive security restrictions on Saturday. Police denied permission for the gathering, citing procedural and law-and-order concerns, and deployed barricades and checkpoints across parts of the capital. Restrictions on transport and mobile internet in some areas added to the disruption, while opposition leaders, students, lawyers and activists were detained as they attempted to join the protest.The police action also prompted separate legal interventions. Chief Justice Surya Kant communicated to authorities that lawyers detained while peacefully protesting outside the Supreme Court should be released, following an urgent letter from the Supreme Court Bar Association.The association had said several advocates were taken to the Yamuna Sports Complex.CPM general secretary MA Baby also moved the Supreme Court challenging restrictions imposed ahead of the protest, including curbs on metro services and mobile internet connectivity. Trinamool Congress spokesperson Saket Gokhale separately approached the Delhi High Court’s acting chief justice, seeking suo motu intervention over transport restrictions.
Article Summary: The Supreme Court will hear on Sunday a plea seeking contempt proceedings against authorities for allegedly violating its October 9 direction. The dispute stems from restrictions imposed ahead of the Cockroach Janta Party’s (CJP) proposed demonstration at Jantar Mantar on October 10.

Article Title: ‘Is peacefully raising your voice a crime?’ CJP alleges Delhi Police dragged, forcibly detained protesters
Article Text:
CJP claims activists are being dragged, pushed by Delhi police

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: The Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) on Saturday accused Delhi Police of forcibly detaining its activists and dragging protesters attempting to reach Jantar Mantar for a demonstration demanding Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation over alleged irregularities in electoral rolls.More than 7,000 people were detained across the national capital, while six police personnel were injured after stones were allegedly hurled at two locations. Police are also set to register an FIR in connection with the alleged assault on personnel.In a post accompanying a video purportedly showing police detaining activists and taking them away, CJP said: “CJP’S TEAM FORCEFULLY DETAINED!”“Delhi Police is pushing, dragging and detaining people for peacefully protesting!” the party wrote, adding, “Is peacefully raising your voice a crime now?”CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke, co-convener Saurav Das and leader Ashutosh Ranka were detained aboard their flight after it landed at Delhi airport, according to the party. Legal affairs head Ratna Singh was also reportedly detained earlier outside her residence in New Delhi.A video from the aircraft showed Dipke challenging the officers. “I have come to be arrested, arrest me ... I am not afraid of you guys,” he said. An officer responded, “No, this is not an arrest. Please cooperate.”Delhi Police had denied permission for the proposed demonstration, with reports citing the late submission of the request as the reason.The authorities imposed extensive security restrictions, with barricades and personnel deployed to prevent protesters from reaching the designated venue.The protest was called over alleged electoral-roll irregularities and the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise, with demonstrators demanding Kumar’s resignation. Several INDIA bloc leaders and activists were also detained, including Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) national convenor Arvind Kejriwal and former West Bengal chief minister Mamata Banerjee.In a post on X, Kejriwal said, "This is worse than the Emergency. It’s official.. we are living under an absolute dictatorship ruled by Modi. Arresting cockroaches straight off their flight shows an unprecedented level of fear. PM Modi clearly knows he only won the election through vote chori and now he is hell-bent on protecting his fraud by completely crushing democracy. Gyanesh must go, but so must Modi.."Banerjee, detained with Trinamool Congress leaders after staging a sit-in, also echoed: “This has gone beyond an Emergency; it has become a Super Emergency.”Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi expressed solidarity with the protesters and challenged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to detain all those participating. “Arrest all the leaders. Arrest all the young people. Arrest us all,” Gandhi said.The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), meanwhile, criticised the protest. Party leader Sambit Patra described it as a “flop show” and called the detentions a victory of democracy over “mob rule”.A police officer said six personnel were injured, with stones allegedly thrown at security personnel at two locations. The injured were taken to nearby hospitals, and the circumstances surrounding their injuries were being ascertained.
Article Summary: Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) accuses Delhi Police of forcibly detaining its activists. Protesters were attempting to reach Jantar Mantar for a demonstration demanding Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation. Article Title: ‘Loud slogans, selective action’: BJP chief Nabin questions Rahul’s silence on allegations against Congress MP after JNU dismissal
Article Text:
Prof Angomcha Bimol Akoijam has been dismissed from Jawaharlal Nehru University due to sexual harassment allegations.

(With PTI inputs)

NEW DELHI: BJP president Nitin Nabin on Saturday questioned Congress leader Rahul Gandhi 's silence over sexual harassment allegations against Congress MP and professor Angomcha Bimol Akoijam.Accusing the Lok Sabha leader of the opposition of resorting to “loud slogans and selective action”, Nabin asked whether Rahul Gandhi would remove Akoijam from the Congress or reserve his moral outrage for “political convenience”.In a post on X, Nabin said, “The mask is off the self-proclaimed champions of women's rights and the 'Smash the Patriarchy' brigade.”His remarks came a day after Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU) dismissed Akoijam with immediate effect following an inquiry that found him guilty of the allegations. Article Title: 'Seek to turn Delhi into battleground': CM Rekha Gupta slams CJP, Rahul & Kejriwal amid anti-SIR protests
Article Text:
In her statement, CM Rekha Gupta slammed both Rahul and Kerjiwal along with CJP

NEW DELHI: Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta on Saturday accused Congress leader Rahul Gandhi and AAP supremo Arvind Kejriwal of trying to turn the national capital into a “battleground” along with the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), as police detained thousands of protesters attempting to reach Jantar Mantar for a demonstration against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.In a post on X, Gupta said the capital would not be held hostage to political protests and alleged that the Opposition was seeking to vent its frustration over electoral defeats by disrupting public life.“Rejected by the countrymen, leaders Rahul Gandhi and Arvind Kejriwal, in league with their B-team CJP, seek to turn Delhi into a battleground. Why, after all, are these leaders so hell-bent on venting the frustration of their nonstop defeats on the public? What offense have the residents of Delhi committed, who are already tormented by the chaos on the streets?” she wrote.She targeted Kejriwal, alleging that he was attempting to disrupt peace and safety in Delhi for his “political self-interest”. “Let it be known: Delhi will not be held hostage. There will be a resolute fight against the politics of spreading anarchy under the guise of democracy and challenging the people's mandate,” she asserted.Further continuing her jabs while hailing PM modi, she also said, "Delhi voted for development.Due to the unprecedented public support, PM Modi has become the leader who, in the history of India's electoral politics, has been sworn in as Prime Minister for the third consecutive term. But parties mired in dynastic politics and opportunism simply cannot digest this public backing. Arvind Kejriwal, the instigator of anarchy who has bestowed upon himself the title of Delhi's owner, is attempting to disrupt the peace and security of Delhiites for his political self-interest. "In her statement, she also posed multiple questions such as, "Who will take responsibility for the troubles of employees heading to work, laborers earning a daily wage to support their families, and patients trying to reach hospitals? Are your political ambitions greater even than the livelihoods, safety, and peace of millions of families in Delhi?"The remarks came amid heightened security across Delhi, where police had denied permission for the CJP-led protest over alleged irregularities in the Election Commission’s functioning and the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. Article Title: Evening news wrap: Delhi in grips of anti-CEC stir; oppn leaders & protesters detained, BJP targets Congress
Article Text:
Delhi in grips of anti-CEC stir; oppn leaders & protesters detained, BJP targets Congress.

Former Bengal chief minister Mamata Banerjee and Pinarayi Vijayan, opposition leader were detained by the Delhi Police during the ongoing CEC protest.

India warned Pakistan against using nuclear weapons as a means of political coercion, asserting that New Delhi would not yield to nuclear blackmail.

The Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) leaders failed to reach Jantar Mantar for their planned protest, as key members were detained by police before reaching the venue.

The Bharatiya Janata Party called Rahul Gandhi a “nalayak neta” over his remarks following a meeting between an INDIA bloc delegation and President Droupadi Murmu.

BJP MP Sambit Patra on Saturday dismissed the Cockroach Janta Party’s (CJP) proposed protest at Delhi’s Jantar Mantar as a “flop show”.

Here are the top stories of the day:

SIR protest: Former CMs among opposition leaders detained from Delhi

India warns Pakistan at UN against nuclear threat

What’s happening at Jantar Mantar? CJP’s ‘cockroaches’ grounded before anti-SIR showdown

'Nalayak neta': BJP accuses Rahul of dragging President into 'street fights', creating 'anarchy'

'Anarchists have failed, planned to hold Delhi hostage': BJP slams Jantar Mantar stir

Former West Bengal chief minister Mamata Banerjee and Kerala leader of opposition in Lok Sabha Pinarayi Vijayan were detained by Delhi Police on Saturday during demonstrations against chief election commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.Mamata Banerjee was detained from South Avenue along with Trinamool Congress leaders Derek O’Brien, Dola Sen and other party members. Several CPM leaders were also taken into custody during the protest.Former Delhi chief minister Arvind Kejriwal was detained as well.Following the detentions, CPM leaders took to social media to condemn the police action. Party leaders in Kerala also criticised the move and called for protests in response.India on Friday issued a stern warning to Pakistan against using the threat of nuclear weapons to exert political pressure, asserting that New Delhi would not give in to nuclear blackmail. It also cautioned that any terrorist attack against the country would be met with an appropriate response.Exercising its Right of Reply at the United Nations general assembly’s first committee, which focuses on disarmament and international security, India stressed that nuclear weapons should not be viewed as “routine instruments of statecraft”.Anmol Sher Singh Bedi, senior adviser (disarmament) at India’s permanent mission to the conference on disarmament in Geneva, delivered the response after Pakistan raised the issue of Jammu and Kashmir.Rejecting Islamabad’s claims over the region, Bedi reiterated India’s position, stating, “Jammu and Kashmir is an integral and inalienable part of India.”The Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) leaders were unable to reach Delhi’s Jantar Mantar as planned after key members of the outfit were detained before arriving at the protest venue, throwing its ‘Jantar Mantar 2.0’ plans into disarray. The extensive security measures across the national capital, which reportedly resulted in more than 1,500 detentions, further affected the anticipated turnout at the demonstration against chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke and party leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were detained by Delhi Police upon their arrival at Indira Gandhi International Airport from Mumbai.The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) on Saturday called Rahul Gandhi a “nalayak neta” over his remarks after a delegation of the INDIA bloc met President Droupadi Murmu. The party accused the leader of the opposition in Lok Sabha of misrepresenting the interaction and dragging the country’s highest constitutional office into the political controversy surrounding allegations of “vote chori”.Addressing a press conference, BJP national spokesperson Sambit Patra challenged Rahul Gandhi’s assertion that the president had not rejected the opposition’s allegations of electoral irregularities. Patra argued that receiving a memorandum did not imply that the president agreed with the claims made in it.“Yesterday, you saw that some political leaders had gone to Rashtrapati Bhavan. Rahul Gandhi’s statement after coming out of the Rashtrapati Bhavan was equal to that of an incompetent leader, ‘Nalayak neta’,” Patra said.BJP MP Sambit Patra on Saturday dismissed the Cockroach Janata Party’s (CJP) proposed protest at Delhi’s Jantar Mantar as a “flop show”, claiming that the “anarchists” who sought to hold the national capital “hostage” had failed in their attempt.“Jantar Mantar’s story is not India’s story. What is happening at Jantar Mantar, what you can see on TV and a few social media handles, is not India’s story. India is calm and going ahead under good governance,” Patra said. The BJP MP alleged that certain “anarchist forces” had been spreading unrest in a corner of Delhi over the past few days. He claimed that their efforts had failed, describing the proposed protest as a “flop show” that had “completely collapsed”. “There was an attempt to hold India, the national capital, captive; that there be arson here, that there be violence here. But today, ‘loktantra’ has triumphed over bheedtantra,” Patra said.

Article Title: ‘Their core characteristic is cowardice’: Rahul Gandhi targets PM Modi, RSS; backs youth protesting against CEC

NEW DELHI: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi on Saturday backed youth protesters demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.The Lok Sabha leader of the opposition said he had been fighting Prime Minister Narendra Modi and the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS), the ideological mentor of the ruling BJP, for “over a decade now” and knew them “inside out, like the back of my hand."“The core characteristic of these people is cowardice. Narendra Modi, (Union home minister) Amit Shah, Gyanesh Kumar and (National Security Advisor) Ajit Doval are slowly finding the space closing around them. We are closing that space,” Rahul Gandhi said in a video message on X.“Mr Modi, do whatever you want. Call out all the police. Arrest all the leaders. Arrest all the young people. Arrest us all,” he added.He further claimed to have “all the information we need,” an apparent reference to proof of what he describes as “vote chori” (vote theft) by the BJP in collusion with the Election Commission.“We are going to defend our Constitution. We are going to protect the voice of the Indian people.And we are going to ensure that what was done to India over the last 10-15 years will never, ever be done again,” the Raebareli MP further stated.“Youth of India, I am proud of you. Keep protesting. We are standing with you. We are going to ensure that this regime and the people who have attacked our Constitution are defeated,” Rahul Gandhi asserted.His remarks came amid a protest led by the youth pressure group Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) against CEC Gyanesh Kumar at Jantar Mantar in Delhi on Saturday.Delhi Police detained more than 3,000 protesters attempting to reach the site. Article Title: Turn any spot into your own Jantar Mantar, says Arvind Kejriwal
Article Text:
Arvind Kejriwal called on individuals across India to transform any location into their personal Jantar Mantar for protests





NEW DELHI: AAP national convener Arvind Kejriwal Saturday called on people across the country to reach Delhi and turn any spot where police stop them into their own ‘Jantar Mantar’.Kejriwal and AAP functionaries were detained while heading to Jantar Mantar to join the protest over alleged irregularities in the electoral roll revision. He alleged that Prime Minister Narendra Modi was “crushing democracy to cover up democratic fraud”.“Modiji must be stopped from stealing votes; otherwise, this country and its democracy will not survive,” he added.Heavy security deployment was made outside Kejriwal’s residence in Lodhi Estate where the former chief minister and AAP workers started a protest with placards and slogans demanding chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation.Police detained Kejriwal outside his residence along with MP Sanjay Singh and others. AAP workers tried to hold on to Kejriwal, but police carried him to a bus. Some AAP workers managed to hop onto the roof and raised slogans even as the bus started moving.“The youth of this country has now awakened, and they will not be intimidated by Modiji’s dictatorship. Gyanesh Kumar will now have to resign because people are no longer willing to tolerate vote chori,” Kejriwal said before police took him away.“PM Modi and Amit Shah have unleashed a reign of dictatorship in Delhi... They have imposed a climate of dictatorship across the country.This is happening because Modiji had been winning elections by stealing votes,” Kejriwal alleged, adding that now that he has been “caught red-handed, he wants to suppress the issue and continue the same practice”.An AAP functionary claimed that before Kejriwal and his family members could leave home to participate in the protest at Jantar Mantar, Delhi Police surrounded the house. AAP said police also prevented party workers from reaching Kejriwal’s residence.Its headquarters at Pandit Ravi Shankar Shukla Lane was “sealed” as police erected barricades and stopped people from entering or leaving the premises. A group of party functionaries led by MLA Gopal Rai held a protest outside the office.

Article Title: 'What are you so scared of?': TMC calls Mamata Banerjee's detention 'Super Emergency', targets PM Narendra Modi
Article Text:
Former West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee and several party MPs were allegedly detained by the Delhi Police

(With Agency Inputs)





NEW DELHI: The All India Trinamool Congress (TMC) on Saturday launched a sharp attack on Prime Minister Narendra Modi and the central government after former West Bengal chief minister Mamata Banerjee and several party MPs were allegedly detained by Delhi Police during a protest in the national capital.Calling the police action a sign of a "Super Emergency" and a "dark day for democracy", the party accused the authorities of curbing the constitutional right to dissent. It alleged that the leaders were barred from raising slogans or displaying posters before being forced into police vans and taken to an undisclosed location.In a post on X, the party's official handle said, "Super emergency is going on - @MamataOfficial While our Hon’ble Chairperson along with our Hon’ble MPs were peacefully protesting, Delhi Police came and instructed that no slogans and no posters were allowed. Why? "The party further alleged, "Then, they unlawfully forced our Chairperson and our MPs into a police van and are now taking them to an undisclosed location. Why? @narendramodi what are you so scared of? Have you simply forgotten that India is a democratic country and every single person has the right to protest?"Criticising Delhi Police and the Union government, the TMC said, "@DelhiPolice how dare you? Since when did arresting peaceful protesters become the norm in our democracy? When peaceful dissent is met with arrests instead of dialogue, it raises serious questions about the state of our democratic values," the party wrote.Issuing a stern message to the ruling dispensation, the party said, "The Mo–Shah duo may continue to push the limits, but no government is above accountability, and no power is permanent. @narendramodi, REMEMBER THAT! A dark day for democracy. A reminder that the fight to protect it must never stop…"TMC Rajya Sabha MP Samirul Islam also criticised the authorities, alleging that detained party leaders were being driven around Delhi in a police vehicle without being informed of their destination.In a post on X, Samirul Islam wrote, "Is this a Super Emergency? For the past one and a half hours, we have been driving around the entire city of Delhi, and we don't know what they are going to do with us. Isn't this a Super Emergency?"The remarks came shortly after Delhi Police detained a delegation of TMC parliamentarians and leaders protesting in central Delhi. Visuals from the site showed security personnel escorting the leaders into police vans.Meanwhile, around 1,000 protesters had been detained across the national capital by Saturday while attempting to march towards Jantar Mantar for a Cockroach Janta Party (CJP)-led protest demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, Delhi Police sources said.Police continued to take demonstrators into preventive custody after informing them that permission had not been granted for the gathering.CJP activist Abhijeet Dipke, who travelled from Mumbai to Delhi to participate in the protest, posted a video on Instagram alleging that police personnel detained him and his associates as they disembarked from their flight at Delhi airport.In the video, Dipke alleged that police personnel entered the aircraft and attempted to detain them."So, you can see that Delhi Police is entering the plane to arrest us. They are all entering the plane. We just landed. All the Delhi Police officers are standing in the aisle. They are trying to arrest us from inside the plane. The entire Delhi Police is getting on the plane... This is the fear of Narendra Modi... Not even Indira Gandhi did this during the Emergency. All we wanted to do is a peaceful protest, and they are picking us up from the flight like we are criminals," he said.He further alleged, "You can see where the nation is heading. They are here to arrest us directly from the flight. This is something not even Indira Gandhi had done. This is dictatorship, where Delhi Police has entered the flight and is trying to arrest us. Come on, arrest us. We are here to be arrested. Come on, arrest us. We are here to be arrested... We are not afraid of you."Security personnel remained deployed at several locations across the national capital as CJP activists continued their call for a protest against the Election Commission of India (ECI). Entry points to Delhi were placed under heightened security, while 46 Metro stations remained closed, according to the details provided.As part of the security arrangements, the New Delhi district was divided into 20 operational zones, with dedicated detention centres established for each zone, police said."The New Delhi district has been divided into 20 zones, and dedicated detention centres have been set up for each zone. Stadiums across the national capital have also been converted into temporary detention centres," the police added.
Article Summary: The All India Trinamool Congress (TMC) launched a sharp attack on Prime Minister Narendra Modi and the central government. Former West Bengal chief minister Mamata Banerjee and several party MPs were allegedly detained by Delhi Police during a protest in the national capital. Article Title: Visually impaired Beed girl bags MBBS seat after HC intervention
Article Text:
Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar:





An 18-year-old visually impaired girl from Beed, initially declared unfit to study medicine, has secured an MBBS seat after a legal battle in the Bombay High Court. The court’s intervention led to a fresh functional assessment that found her competent to pursue medical education.Syeda Musfira Fatema Rafiuddin has now been admitted to Govt Medical College, Sangli-Miraj.Musfira has congenital low vision caused by albinism, nystagmus and amblyopia. She scored 345 out of 720 in NEET-UG 2026 and secured an All-India OBC-NCL PwBD rank of 796.Her medical aspirations, however, hit a roadblock on Aug 10. The Medical Assessment Board at Sir JJ Group of Hospitals, Mumbai, declared her “ineligible for pursuing medical education”. It cited her visual condition and dependence on low-vision assistive devices.Musfira challenged the decision before the Aurangabad bench of the Bombay high court. Her counsel, advocate Sayyed Tauseef Yaseen, argued before a division bench of Justice Nitin B Suryawanshi and Justice Abasaheb D Shinde that the medical board had merely recorded her diagnosis.It had not conducted a functional or task-based assessment or considered reasonable accommodation, he submitted.Yaseen relied on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, and the Supreme Court judgment in Omkar Ramchandra Gond v Union of India. He argued that Musfira had already demonstrated her ability by competing in a rigorous national-level examination with prescribed magnifying aids. Her functional ability, rather than merely her diagnosis, should, therefore, have been assessed, he submitted.With NEET counselling underway, HC on Sept 22 directed Musfira to approach the appellate forum at Madras Medical College, Chennai, for an urgent reassessment.After evaluating her functional ability with low-vision aids, the appellate forum on Sept 25 declared her eligible and competent to pursue medical education under the PwBD category.A technical issue on the counselling portal then prevented Musfira from opting for the PwBD category. Yaseen approached the high court again on Sept 28. The authorities subsequently undertook to reopen the registration window for Musfira and facilitate her participation in the All-India and state counselling processes.She was subsequently allotted an MBBS seat at Govt Medical College, Sangli-Miraj, and granted admission.On Oct 1, Yaseen informed the high court that Musfira had secured admission. The bench then disposed of her petition as infructuous.
Article Summary: Syeda Musfira Fatema Rafiuddin has congenital low vision caused by albinism, nystagmus and amblyopia. She scored 345 out of 720 in NEET-UG 2026 and secured an All-India OBC-NCL PwBD rank of 796. The Medical Assessment Board at Sir JJ Group of Hospitals, Mumbai, declared her ‘ineligible for pursuing medical education’

Article Title: Three corner contest for Pune graduates, Sena relents makes teachers poll between BJP and Cong

I have spoken to our party chief, who has asked the organisation to support and campaign for me.”Consequently, Pune Graduates’ seat will see a triangular fight. Harshada Jadhav is contesting as the official candidate of NCP (SP), while Dr Smita Jadhav is in the fray as the official candidate of BJP . Meanwhile, NCP rebel Pratap alias Bhaiya Mane withdrew his nomination. Mane said he withdrew at the request of his leader, minister Hasan Mushrif. Interestingly, Mane had earlier approached NCP (SP) chief Sharad Pawar for a ticket, but Pawar declined, stating he no longer trusted leaders from Kagal— the taluka in Kolhapur to which both Mushrif and Mane belong.On the other hand, Mangesh Chivate, the candidate from Eknath Shinde ’s Shiv Sena, withdrew from the race for the Pune Teachers’ constituency. The BJP has nominated Kaustubh Gawade for the seat, who will now face a direct contest against the sitting MLC, Jayant Asgaonkar of Congress , who also hails from Kolhapur. Following his withdrawal, Chivate noted that in his party, the orders of party chief— deputy chief minister Eknath Shinde—are strictly followed, and he complied without questioning the underlying reasons.Sources revealed that CM Devendra Fadnavis and DCM Eknath Shinde held discussions to resolve the impasse. While both leaders initially tried to convince each other, neither relented until the final moments, when Shinde ultimately chose not to stretch the alliance’s friction further and instructed Chivate to pull out.Meanwhile, campaigning has officially begun for the graduates’ constituency. NCP (SP) MLA Jayant Patil, Congress MLA Vishwajeet Kadam, and Sangli MP Vishal Patil have endorsed Harshada Jadhav, urging their supporters to connect with registered graduate voters and secure their support.State BJP president Ravindra Chavan claimed on Friday that the remaining internal differences within Mahayuti alliance over the Pune MLC seats will soon be resolved. While kickstarting the campaign in Pune for alliance candidates Smita Jadhav and Kaustubh Gawade, Chavan told the media: “We will contest this election as a united Mahayuti. Our senior leader Chandrakant Patil will hold a meeting with Mahayuti coordinators from western Maharashtra to iron out any differences and ensure workers from all three alliance parties campaign together. ”(Inputs from Anurag Bende in Pune)
Article Summary: Friday marked the final deadline for withdrawal of nominations for graduates’ and teachers’ constituency MLC elections. Shiv Sena (UBT) has declined to withdraw its candidate, Sunil Modi, who filed his nomination for Pune Graduates’ MLC seat. A consensus could not be reached within Maha Vikas Aghadi (MVA)

Article Title: Rs 1 lakh bribe trap: Navi Mumbai ACB catches circle officer, talathi and woman assistant
Article Text:
The arrested accused were identified as Keshav Dagdu Mohite, Jaihind Birsha Koli (49) and Monika Vijnesh Patil (36).





NAVI MUMBAI: The Navi Mumbai Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) has arrested two revenue officials and a woman assistant for allegedly accepting a Rs 1 lakh bribe from a villager in Chirner, Uran taluka, to register the names of his relatives in the 7/12 extract of a land record.The arrested accused were identified as Keshav Dagdu Mohite (52), circle officer at Koproli in Uran taluka; Jaihind Birsha Koli (49), talathi; and Monika Vijnesh Patil (36), an assistant to the revenue officials.Dharmaraj Sonake, deputy superintendent of police, Navi Mumbai ACB, said the complainant had applied to register the names of the heirs of his deceased sister in the 7/12 extract of their land in Chirner.The land was jointly owned by the complainant's maternal uncle, aunt, brother and sister. The complainant had also applied for deletion of his deceased brother's name and submitted the request to circle officer Mohite and talathi Koli. However, the two officials allegedly demanded Rs 1 lakh from him to process the work.Dy SP Sonake said, "After verification of the complaint on Monday, when it was confirmed that the revenue officers Mohite and Koli had told the complainant to hand over the bribe amount to the accused woman assistant Monika Patil, a trap was laid on Tuesday around 2 pm. After the woman assistant Monika Patil accepted the demanded bribe of Rs 1 lakh from the complainant and handed it over to circle officer Keshav Mohite, both were caught red-handed and arrested. While, the acccused Talathi Jaihind Koli who was involved in the bribe demand was taken into custody from Dronagiri."
Article Summary: The Navi Mumbai Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) has arrested two revenue officials and a woman assistant for allegedly accepting a Rs 1 lakh bribe. The arrested accused were identified as Keshav Dagdu Mohite (52), circle officer at Koproli in Uran taluka; Jaihind Birsha Koli (49), talathi; and Monika Vijnesh Patil (36)

Article Title: Man in Mahindra Thar with duplicate plate molests woman, knocks down another in Kharghar
Article Text:
30-year-old man was apprehended for allegedly molesting a woman and injuring another in Navi Mumbai.





NAVI MUMBAI: A 30-year-old man wearing a mask and driving a red Thar SUV with a duplicate registration number plate was apprehended by the Crime Branch Unit-3 team within 10 hours on Thursday evening.He had allegedly molested a 26-year-old woman walking on the street in Kharghar, around 400metres from Pethpada metro station, on September 30 night and, an hour later, severely injured a 22-year-old woman by knocking her down in Belpada, Sector 3, Kharghar.Acting on a complaint by the woman allegedly molested by the Thar SUV driver, Kharghar police registered an FIR under BNS section 74 for the offence of assault or criminal force against a woman with the intent to outrage her modesty.While, as per the complaint by the injured woman Shrawani Dandekar, a resident of sector 3, Belpada, an FIR under relevant BNS sections and Motor Vehicle Act was registered against the Thar SUV driver for rash and negligent driving causing hurt.The detained aaccused identified as Ali alias Talib Ahsan Nakhvi, a resident of sector 50, Seawoods, Nerul was handed over to Kharghar police for further legal action.Previously, in January 2021, he was arrested by Nerul police in the FIR registered against him for alleged kidnapping, sexual harassment and molestation of a woman.Sanjay Joshi, senior inspector of Kharghar said, "The accused Nakhvi has been detained and subsequently it will be decided whether to arrest him or serve with a notice under Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) for cooperating in police investigating."Audumbar Patil, senior inspector of crime branch unit-3 said, "After an FIR for molestation was registered at Kharghar police station by the victim woman, a resident of sector 34, Kharghar. As per the orders of higher authority, our team started a parallel probe. From the CCTV camera surveillance near the crime scene, we obtained the red Thar SUV's registration number, which was of Vashi RTO passing.""When verified, the registration number was found to be that of a Maruti WagonR car. As the accused had used a duplicate registration number plate, we scrutinized as many as 62 Thar SUVs registered with various Regional Transport Offices (RTOs). Subsequently, we obtained the registration number of a red Thar SUV that was registered with Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar RTO," Patil added.SPI Patil further informed, "The SUV was registered in the name of Ali alias Talib Ahsan Nakhvi, a resident of Devaki Apartment in sector-50, Seawoods. From his mobile number registered with the RTO, his location was tracked.""He was apprehended from Bonkode village, Koparkhairane on Thursday late evening. Upon thorough interrogation, he confessed that he had inappropriately touched the woman pedestrian near Pethpada metro station while he drove his Thar SUV and sped away. He even confessed to have injured a woman pedestrian by hitting her his SUV while driving in Belpada area," he said.
Article Summary: A 30-year-old man wearing a mask and driving a red Thar SUV with a duplicate registration number plate was apprehended by the Crime Branch Unit-3 team on Thursday evening. He had allegedly molested a woman walking on the street in Kharghar, around 400metres from Pethpada metro station, on September 30 night. An hour later, he severely injured a woman by knocking her down in Belpada, Sector 3, KharGHar.

Article Title: 2 women escape from RPF lockup in Navi Mumbai; 1 held after 6 hours, cop suspended
Article Text:
The women removed their sarees, tied one end to the generator on the balcony and climbed down before escaping. (AI image)





NAVI MUMBAI: In a major security lapse at Belapur Railway Protection Force (RPF), two women arrested for allegedly attempting to steal overhead electric wires from the Juinagar railway godown escaped from the lockup after midnight on September 28.One of them was apprehended around six hours later, while the other remains at large.The woman constable on night duty has been suspended and a departmental inquiry has been initiated against her.As per the FIR registered by RPF sub-inspector Milap Parte (52) at Panvel GRP, a case was registered on September 24 under Section 3(a) of the Railway Property (Unauthorized Possession) Act, 1966, Amendment 2012, at Belapur railway police station.The case was based on a written memo submitted by RPF personnel Ravikant Gade regarding the theft of overhead electric wires from the godown at Juinagar railway station on September 21.During the probe, a trap was laid on September 26 and around 1pm, two women were found loitering suspiciously near the Juinagar godown with the alleged intention of committing theft.They were taken into custody and identified as Rupali Kailas Kurhade (30), from Jalna, and Shalibai Ashok Pawar (49), from Bhiwandi.They were arrested after an FIR was registered for attempted theft and produced before a CSMT court, which remanded them to police custody till September 30. They were lodged in the lockup at Belapur RPF police station.Day-shift woman constable Rakhi Malaiya was assigned guard duty at the lockup, after which woman head constable Pooja Bagre was on night duty.Around 2am on September 28, when Bagre had gone to the toilet, the two women allegedly managed to open the lock by inserting their hands through the iron bars of the lockup and jerking it. Police suspect the lock may not have been secured properly.The women then reached the balcony at the rear end of the police station. They removed their sarees, tied one end to the generator on the balcony and climbed down before escaping.The incident was captured on CCTV footage. PSI Parte learnt about the escape after waking up at home around 6.30am and finding several missed calls from head constable Bagre and ASI Rajiv Parsan.Sunil Nila, chief spokesperson of Central Railway, said, "One accused woman Rupali Kurhade was apprehended from near Nerul railway station around 8.45 am. The other accused Shalibai Pawar is still absconding."
Article Summary: The women removed their sarees, tied one end to the generator on the balcony and climbed down before escaping. One of them was apprehended around six hours later, while the other remains at large. The woman constable on night duty has been suspended and a departmental inquiry has been initiated.

Article Title: Thane Shiv Sena (UBT) leader murder: 2 more arrested near Alibag while fleeing to Goa, total 3
Article Text:
Two additional suspects were arrested in connection with the murder of Shiv Sena division chief Pradeep Purnekar.





THANE: The Thane Crime Branch has arrested two more accused in connection with the murder of Shiv Sena (UBT) division chief Pradeep alias Balu Purnekar, taking the total number of arrests in the case to three.The arrested accused have been identified as Nikhil Yadav and Nitesh Pawar alias Bhavdya. The two were apprehended near Alibag while allegedly attempting to flee towards Goa, according to police sources.The Crime Branch reportedly traced the duo following information obtained during the questioning of suspects detained earlier in the case. Police teams had been searching for the accused after Purnekar was shot and attacked with a sharp-edged weapon at his office in Thane.According to investigators, Yadav allegedly opened fire on Purnekar, while Pawar allegedly attacked him with a sharp weapon. Police are now expected to question both accused to establish the sequence of events, the motive and the role of others involved in the alleged conspiracy.The two accused are expected to be produced before the Thane Sessions Court on Friday. Police will also attempt to recover the weapons allegedly used in the murder and investigate how the accused obtained them.Earlier, Prakash alias Papya Shinde was arrested in connection with the case. The police have also formed a Special Investigation Team (SIT) headed by DCP (Crime) Amarsingh Jadhav to conduct a detailed probe into the killing.The investigation is continuing, with police probing the alleged conspiracy, the role of other suspects and the possible involvement of the absconding accused.
Article Summary: The arrested accused have been identified as Nikhil Yadav and Nitesh Pawar alias Bhavdya. The two were apprehended near Alibag while allegedly attempting to flee towards Goa. Police are now expected to question both accused to establish the sequence of events, the motive and the role of others involved.

Article Title: Disha Salian case: Father, lawyer seek police protection, allege threats from Sena (UBT) leaders
Article Text:
Ojha questioned Aaditya Thackeray’s ‘Y-plus’ security, saying those who raised the issue and allegedly faced threats remained unprotected.

(With agency inputs)





THANE: Advocate Nilesh Ojha on Sunday said that Disha Salian’s father, Satish Salian, Sameer Wankhede, Ashutosh Pathak and he have sought police protection, alleging that they received threats from Shiv Sena (UBT) leaders.Ojha, who is representing Satish Salian in the case, said they have written to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Union home minister Amit Shah, the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI), the Chief Justice of India and Maharashtra chief minister Devendra Fadnavis, seeking protection."The CBI FIR was registered, and a letter was immediately written requesting police protection for four individuals: Satish Salian, our witness Sameer Wankhede, myself, and Ashutosh Pathak, " Ojha told news agency ANI.Ojha questioned the provision of ‘Y-plus’ security to Aaditya Thackeray , saying those who brought the matter to light and allegedly faced threats had been left without protection."The letter clearly states, citing records from your Home Ministry and the Narcotics Bureau, that it is evident that Aditya Thackeray is involved in the drug trade. Furthermore, an FIR has now been registered against him regarding gang rape, murder, and a cover-up.Several other high-profile individuals and police officers are also implicated as accused in this matter," he said."We have already provided all prima facie evidence; the CBI has obtained everything necessary during the investigation to secure a conviction. Yet, the accused currently enjoys 'Y-plus' security provided by your administration. Meanwhile, those who brought this matter to light and those facing direct threats from individuals like Sanjay Raut were left unprotected," the advocate added.He further said that providing security was mandatory under the Witness Protection Scheme and Supreme Court guidelines, and alleged that their request for protection had not been acted upon.He further added, "Providing security is mandatory under the Witness Protection Scheme and Supreme Court guidelines. Yet, they failed to do so. Consequently, we compiled all the material and handed it over to the CBI. We also urged them to investigate the role of Police Commissioner Deven Bharti and determine why police protection was not granted.""We have given a copy of this to the CBI, along with Prime Minister Modi ji, the Home Minister, the Chief Justice of India, and the Chief Minister," Ojha said.Disha Salian was found dead in Mumbai on June 8, 2020. Her death was initially registered as an Accidental Death Report (ADR).Salian died days before actor Sushant Singh Rajput , whose death also led to a high-profile investigation and widespread public controversy.Bombay High Court directed the CBI to register a formal First Information Report (FIR) and launch a fresh probe.As the probe progresses, Satish Salian, accompanied by his lawyer Nilesh Ojha, has submitted a pen drive containing material they described as evidence related to Disha Salian’s death.Meanwhile, Aaditya Thackeray has denied the allegations and responded to the defamation notice issued by Satish Salian.
Article Summary: Disha Salian’s father, Satish Salian, Sameer Wankhede, Ashutosh Pathak and he have sought police protection. They allege that they received threats from Shiv Sena (UBT) leaders. Ojha questioned the provision of ‘Y-plus’ security to Aaditya Thackeray. He said those who raised the issue and allegedly faced threats remained unprotected.

Article Title: Nine transsexuals booked for robbing transgender person of ₹6.7L
Article Text:
Indian currency notes for representational purposes

Pune:





A 30-year-old transsexual person filed a complaint on Friday with Kothrud police, stating that nine transgender people assaulted and threatened the person with religious conversion.The accused also robbed the complainant of Rs 6.7 lakh on Friday.Kothrud police have registered a case under the Maharashtra Freedom of Religion Act, the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019, and robbery against nine transgender people.According to the FIR, the complainant lives near a temple in Kothrud. They threatened and asked the complainant to abandon their religion and convert to another religion.Kothrud police said the suspects assaulted the complainant with a belt and bamboo sticks. They also threatened to kill the complainant did not give them 50% of the money earned through begging. The suspects then allegedly robbed the complainant of Rs 6.7 lakh cash.
Article Summary: A 30-year-old transsexual person filed a complaint on Friday with Kothrud police, stating that nine transgender people assaulted and threatened the person with religious conversion.
